mapper.sql: user_idx, user_id, nickname, user_email, user_role, member_grade, cash_balance, mileage_balance, point_balance, level_no, exp_points
mapper.select: SELECT FROM USERS WHERE user_idx = #{userIdx} FOR UPDATE

SELECT point_shop_item_idx, item_code, item_name, item_type, point_price, is_repeatable, is_active, CAST(item_payload_json AS CHAR) AS item_payload_json, description FROM POINT_SHOP_ITEM WHERE item_code = #{itemCode} AND is_active = 1 FOR UPDATE
SELECT item_code FROM USER_POINT_ITEM_INVENTORY WHERE user_idx = #{userIdx} AND is_active = 1

SELECT inv.point_inventory_idx, inv.user_idx, inv.item_code, item.item_name, item.item_type, item.point_price, inv.quantity, inv.is_active, CAST(item.item_payload_json AS CHAR) AS item_payload_json, item.description, inv.acquired_at, inv.last_used_at, CASE WHEN equip.point_equip_idx IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS is_equipped, equip.equip_slot FROM USER_POINT_ITEM_INVENTORY inv JOIN POINT_SHOP_ITEM item ON inv.item_code = item.item_code LEFT JOIN USER_POINT_ITEM_EQUIP equip ON equip.user_idx = inv.user_idx AND equip.item_code = inv.item_code WHERE inv.user_idx = #{userIdx} AND inv.is_active = 1 ORDER BY item.item_type ASC, inv.acquired_at DESC

SELECT inv.point_inventory_idx, inv.user_idx, inv.item_code, item.item_name, item.item_type, item.point_price, inv.quantity, inv.is_active, CAST(item.item_payload_json AS CHAR) AS item_payload_json, item.description, inv.acquired_at, inv.last_used_at, CASE WHEN equip.point_equip_idx IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS is_equipped, equip.equip_slot FROM USER_POINT_ITEM_INVENTORY inv JOIN POINT_SHOP_ITEM item ON inv.item_code = item.item_code LEFT JOIN USER_POINT_ITEM_EQUIP equip ON equip.user_idx = inv.user_idx AND equip.item_code = inv.item_code WHERE inv.user_idx = #{userIdx} AND inv.item_code = #{itemCode} AND inv.is_active = 1 LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO USER_POINT_PURCHASE_HISTORY ( user_idx, item_code, quantity, unit_price, total_price, purchase_status, purchased_at, detail_message, created_at ) VALUES ( #{userIdx}, #{itemCode}, #{quantity}, #{unitPrice}, #{totalPrice}, #{purchaseStatus}, NOW(), #{detailMessage}, NOW() )

INSERT INTO USER_POINT_ITEM_INVENTORY ( user_idx, item_code, quantity, is_active, acquired_at, last_used_at, related_purchase_idx, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{userIdx}, #{itemCode}, 1, 1, NOW(), NULL, #{relatedPurchaseIdx}, NOW(), NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE quantity = quantity + 1, is_active = 1, related_purchase_idx = VALUES(related_purchase_idx), updated_at = NOW()

INSERT INTO USER_POINT_HISTORY ( user_idx, change_type, source_type, source_id, amount, balance_after, detail_message, actor_user_idx, related_purchase_idx, created_at ) VALUES ( #{userIdx}, #{changeType}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceId}, #{amount}, #{balanceAfter}, #{detailMessage}, #{actorUserIdx}, #{relatedPurchaseIdx}, NOW() )

INSERT INTO USER_POINT_ITEM_EQUIP ( user_idx, equip_slot, item_code, equipped_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{userIdx}, #{equipSlot}, #{itemCode}, NOW(), NOW(), NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE item_code = VALUES(item_code), equipped_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW()
